Qwen Image 2.1 has native 2K (2048*2048) support for direct output.

Default (custom_size off): output follows image_1's aspect ratio, scaled to about resolution*resolution (default 1024, multiple of 32). This is not image_1's original pixel size. Set resolution to 0 to keep original sizes (rounded to 32).

Turn on custom_size to use the ResolutionSelector width/height as the canvas. Keep it close to the resized image_1 size, or the edit can shift.

Show one clearly adult East Asian woman with refined enduring features, a soft face, bright clear eyes, fair natural skin texture, and a pure gentle temperament. She looks directly into the lens as if looking softly at the viewer. She wears a moon-white, cream-white, or pale blue-white silk-satin ancient-style dress with real folds, delicate flower-branch embroidery, and flowing cuffs. Her black hair is in a semi-updo with loose strands, a slight night breeze, and restrained white floral, pearl, or jade hair ornaments. The action is serving tea, with correctly proportioned spout, handle, cup mouth, natural liquid direction, slender natural fingers, and an elegant gentle gesture. A vertically framed, cinematic night photograph shows an adult East Asian-presenting woman positioned prominently over a narrow historic waterside walkway or balcony, leaning forward as if offering food or drink directly to the camera. The top-left area contains rough, stacked stone architecture forming part of an arched passageway or elevated bridge wall; the stones are irregular rectangular slabs in muted gray-brown tones with deep mortar lines, cracks, and aged texture. Vines climb along the ledge at the extreme left edge, holding clusters of dark green oval leaves and several tiny pink-red blossoms. Just beneath them hang warm cylindrical lanterns made of translucent ribbed glass or paper panels, glowing golden yellow-orange and attached to traditional building eaves or architectural brackets. Behind these lights, another smaller hanging lamp sits deeper in the passage, adding repeated points of warm illumination.

Across the right half of the background, an old urban streetscape stretches diagonally backward along a river or canal. Dark tiled rooftops, steep eaves, wooden facades, balconies, and warmly lit windows appear softly out of focus. Several lanterns line the exterior walls and bridges, their orange interiors contrasting strongly with the deep blue evening sky. The ground-level setting suggests rain-wet pavement or stone paths reflected by scattered lamps, while misty atmospheric haze gives the far buildings a dreamlike softness. A large bright full moon or circular celestial disk occupies the upper-middle right sky area, partially veiled by clouds and aligned visually above the sloping architecture, creating a dramatic nocturnal backdrop.

In the central and lower portions, the main figure dominates the composition in close three-quarter view. She has fair skin, an oval face, dark almond-shaped eyes, naturally shaped eyebrows, long lashes, subtle eyeliner, soft blush, lightly highlighted cheeks, and muted rose lips parted in a calm, attentive expression. Fine forehead lines and delicate smile lines contribute to a serene, human quality. Her black hair is styled loosely with wispy strands falling around her temples and cheeks; much of it is gathered into an elegant bun or swept-back arrangement decorated with dangling pearl-like and crystal-like floral hairpins, thin metallic branches, small bead chains, and tassel drops. Long drop earrings with ornate silver-toned filigree shapes catch the light near her jawline. She wears flowing moon-white, cream-white, or pale blue-white embroidered silk-robe garments resembling hanfu-inspired attire: wide draped sleeves, smooth silky fabric, stitched vine or branch motifs, and floral appliqués with leaf-shaped patterns and pale threadwork. The garment catches ambient light, producing creamy highlights and darker fold shadows.

Her arms extend toward the viewer from the lower center of the image, creating strong perspective distortion between her extended hands and the softer face in the background plane. One bare forearm crosses horizontally from the lower-left region toward the center, leading to a rounded cup held close to the lens; the other arm supports it underneath from the right-front area, reinforcing the sense that she is presenting it carefully. The vessel being offered is a complete teapot with correctly proportioned spout and handle, made of pale speckled ceramic with fine brown flecks and faint crackle-like decoration. Inside the teapot rests a single red-pink flower petal floating visibly on the very dark surface. Her fingers are slender, nails short-to-medium length and neatly manicured in a nude beige tone; they curl naturally around the base and sides of the teapot without jewelry competing with the gesture.

Along the lower-left corner, additional tableware lies close to the camera and slightly out of focus, including small matching bowls or cups filled nearly to the brim with dark broth or tea. These vessels echo the same earthy ceramic color, rounded profiles, matte-speckled surfaces, and artisanal handmade appearance as the front teapot. Around them run thick, rustic stone balustrades or stair railings occupying the lower band of the frame. The railing consists of horizontal and vertical rock-faced segments, chipped corners, moss-dark crevices, and worn gray-beige surfaces suggesting outdoor age and damp conditions.

On the left rear within the shaded corridor, indistinct seated figures occupy tables or benches illuminated by multiple lanterns, rendered almost silhouette-like due to darkness and shallow focus. Farther down the bridge or terrace in the middle distance, several people walk together along the canal path; they are reduced to softened bodies and legs in neutral clothing colors such as tan, navy, brown, and off-white, with movement implied by posture and spacing rather than sharp detail. On the right middle-lower background, two walking figures stand closer together near the parapet: one adult man seen from behind in a gray-blue shirt and trousers, and one child-sized companion wearing a mustard-yellow outer layer. Their backs and relaxed upright stance suggest casual conversation while looking toward the water or street beyond them. Additional dimly dressed pedestrians populate the winding lane further right, all surrounded by warm storefront lights and reflective wet-looking cobblestones or packed-earth surfaces.

The entire picture uses shallow depth of field: the woman’s face, hands, and immediate ceramics receive the most attention, though parts of her sleeves and the nearest dish are gently blurred by closeness to the focal plane, while the moonlit cityscape dissolves into creamy circles of lantern bokeh. Lighting is primarily practical and environmental: warm candle lanterns cast amber highlights from the left and along the street, while cooler blue twilight illuminates the sky, mountains or distant hills at horizon height, the woman’s complexion, and the folds of her clothing. Shadows fall dramatically across stonework, sleeves, and faces, giving the image a painterly historical-drama atmosphere. The shot reads like editorial fashion photography inspired by classical Chinese court aesthetics combined with fantasy-period travel imagery, using realistic lenses, close-range handheld perspective, rich contrast, filmic color grading, detailed textures, moody exposure, selective focus, and romantic low-light ambience.

The image is a wide hand-drawn charcoal sketch portrait of a young East Asian woman rendered in a rough ink-and-charcoal illustration style, set against a textured off-white paper background with subtle grain and faint tonal variation across its surface. The background is a flat, unbleached cream paper with visible fibre texture, slightly darker at the edges suggesting a scanned or photographed sheet. In the upper-left quadrant, a large handwritten brush-script headline reads "Still Here" in thick black strokes, the letters loose and expressive with uneven weight, the word "Still" stacked above "Here" and a short horizontal dash beneath. Directly below that headline, two lines of small black serif type read "Same me." and "A quieter day." in a lighter, more restrained weight than the brush-script above. The central subject occupies the middle and lower half of the frame: a young woman depicted from the shoulders up, her face turned slightly toward the viewer with a calm, neutral expression. Her hair is rendered in dense, heavy charcoal strokes, long and dark, falling past her shoulders on both sides and parted near the centre of her head, with the texture of individual strokes visible throughout. Her face is left mostly unshaded, the paper white showing through for skin, while her eyes are drawn as small dark ovals with defined brows above them, and her lips are a small dark mark. On the upper-left of her head, a small butterfly-shaped hair clip is suggested with a few delicate lines, echoing the accessory in the source photograph. She wears a scoop-neck top rendered in rough cross-hatched charcoal, the leopard-print pattern suggested through irregular dark spots and patches rather than detailed rendering, the neckline curving low across her chest. A thin gold necklace with a small round pendant hangs at her collarbone, drawn as a fine single line with a tiny circle at its centre. On the right side of the frame, roughly at mid-height, a small black serif label reads "NO. 01" with a thin horizontal rule drawn directly beneath it. Below that, in the lower-right area, three short lines of small black serif type read "Some faces" "carry" "silent stories." stacked vertically with generous leading. The lighting is flat and even across the entire composition, with no cast shadows or highlights, consistent with a hand-drawn illustration on a paper surface where all depth comes from line weight and stroke density rather than light direction. The overall composition is balanced and minimalist, with the dense dark charcoal mass of the figure anchoring the centre while the sparse text elements float in the negative space on either side, creating a quiet, contemplative mood on a restrained palette of black ink on cream paper.
